The leaf shows scattered white/grey powdery spots distributed across the surface. These are not black (ruling out Sooty Mould), not sunken brown lesions (ruling out Anthracnose), and not bark/twig symptoms (ruling out Die Back). The whitish, dusty-looking patches are characteristic of powdery mildew colonies on a mango leaf.
